what: In a section with several items lined up vertically, a picture panel (388px) stands in the center, and once the panel’s center reaches the screen center it sticks (sticky) to the screen center and follows down to the end of the section. For each step (section height divided by item count, advanced by half a step), the panel background cross-fades in .4s ease and the person illustration rises from 40px below in .4s — each time the text line beside it passes, the center picture is swapped for that item’s.

options.[data-fx-part=figure]: Image panel to stick (required) — place in the center of the section
options.[data-fx-part=slides]: Layers to swap inside the panel (several allowed — one base layer, one people layer). Each child is one item
options.narrow: Below this width (px) the panel is hidden (the phone version where each item has its own image), default 1080 · 0 means never hidden
options.--fx-rise: Distance the people layer rises (via style), default 40px
options.look: fade: Both layers swap in place by overlapping (they do not rise up)

note: The original swaps the panel between absolute ↔ fixed on every scroll and re-measures left (js-sticky). The same position and column split are done with CSS sticky so they do not break even inside an inner scroll panel. The panel starts at the top of the section and stops at its bottom

from.where: index.html .service__feature (three services: the 388px hill graphic in the center changes to green, blue and yellow backgrounds and a person for each item)
